depth_history.shortcut_targeted: The determinant condition is exactly the proper-3-coloring constraint s_u != s_v.
depth_history.edit_summary: Change the characteristic matrix so its determinant is not a square of s_u-s_v—preferably making compatibility depend asymmetrically on the ordered pair—and remove or revise the claim that swapping u and v gives an equivalent condition.

resistant_to: Reduces each matrix test to a precomputed compatibility relation, effectively graph coloring with three values.
Treats every edge as a proper 3-coloring constraint and searches colors 1, 2, 3 in order.
